# Find the relevant SimpleNote by searching for likely keywords
from datetime import datetime
now = datetime.now()
month_key = now.strftime('%Y-%m')

# login to simple_note already done earlier? We'll login again to be safe
pw = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
simple_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='diwils@gmail.com', password=pw['simple_note'])['access_token']

keywords = ['Amazon', 'amazon', 'expenses', 'expense', 'log']

for kw in keywords[:2]:
    notes = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_token, query=kw, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        notes.extend(page)
        if len(page) < 20:
            break
        page_index += 1
    print('keyword', kw, 'matches', len(notes))
    # print up to first 10 titles with ids
    print([(n['note_id'], n['title']) for n in notes[:10]])

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from datetime import datetime

# Recompute month totals and entry line (deterministic based on already fetched orders)
# Login tokens
pw = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
simple_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='diwils@gmail.com', password=pw['simple_note'])['access_token']
amazon_token = apis.amazon.login(username='diwils@gmail.com', password=pw['amazon'])['access_token']

now = datetime.now()
month_key = now.strftime('%Y-%m')
month_label = f"{now.month:02d}/{str(now.year)[-2:]}"

# Fetch all orders (page loop)
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_orders = []
while True:
    page = apis.amazon.show_orders(access_token=amazon_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_orders.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

month_orders = [o for o in all_orders if o.get('created_at','').startswith(month_key)]
order_ids = [o['order_id'] for o in month_orders]

# Sum paid amounts with 2-decimal rounding
total_cents = Decimal('0')
for o in month_orders:
    total_cents += Decimal(str(o.get('paid_amount',0.0))).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
month_total_str = f"{total_cents:.2f}".rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
entry_line = f"- {month_label} => ${month_total_str}"

# Load note content and check whether entry already exists
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=simple_token)
content = note['content']
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
existing = [ln for ln in lines if ln.startswith('-') and month_label in ln]

print('verification_table')
print('month_label', month_label)
print('order_ids', order_ids)
print('orders_count', len(order_ids))
print('month_total', month_total_str)
print('entry_line', entry_line)
print('existing_month_lines', existing)
